sourceText: User asked to complete historical seed backfill and trial/matched-control/timer automation, then convergence_check revealed two annotation errors from the new B-5f5b smoke files that must be corrected so the completed work is actually clean.
normalizedOutcome: The two B-5f5b smoke files have compliant @task annotations, convergence_check no longer reports the two annotation errors, and no playbook behavior or stored candidate/trial data is changed.
acceptanceClaim: Direct annotation validation reports zero errors and convergence_check reports Code annotations compliant=true after adding only @changes metadata to the two scoped smoke files.
